meaning: Specification data only. No production consumer or launch command exists. All new numerical defaults require student review.

global.weights: FP32 unfused saved EMA, eval, requires_grad false
global.precision: CUDA float16 autocast; float16 normalized inputs divided by 255
global.pixels: Existing prepared 8-bit grayscale at original dimensions, replicated to three equal channels
global.resize: Reuse wrist_eval.sliced.resize_and_pad and pinned ops.scale_boxes with actual per-axis gains
global.global_shape: Required checkpoint-independent metadata shape profile for paired validation; no silent switch to default single-image padding
global.checkpoint: Run-manifest input; identical checkpoint for global and local views; not part of the algorithm parameter identity

candidates.effective_short_side: min(x2-x1,y2-y1)*768/max(W,H), using original coordinates before crop planning
candidates.source: Retained post-global-NMS pool; never GT or an extra model pass
candidates.no_candidate_action: Return original global rows unchanged, including their order; zero local calls

scoring.confidence_direction: Increasing confidence means increasing credibility priority, not increasing uncertainty

selection.diversity: Best geometrically feasible candidate per represented target class first; rank those heads by the same score key; then pooled remaining candidates
selection.coalescing: Attach a seed to an existing ROI only when ROI IoU>=0.7 AND its expanded integer anchor envelope is contained in that ROI; keep the existing crop, never enlarge its union
selection.coalescing_tie: Highest ROI IoU, then earliest ROI ID

crop.expanded_anchor: Expand original prediction by 2*max(W,H)/768 on each side, clip to image, floor low edges and ceil high edges
crop.placement: Nearest integer center around original candidate, half-up rounding; clamp to the integer origin intervals that contain its expanded envelope and stay inside the image
crop.skip: Reject infeasible geometry or max(cw,ch)>=max(W,H); do not consume a local-pass slot
crop.pixel_region: Original prepared image[y0:y0+ch,x0:x0+cw], without rewriting the image
crop.local_padding: Existing per-view half-stride default, not the global batch shape
crop.coordinate_restoration: Pinned ops.scale_boxes to crop pixels using actual gains/padding, then add [x0,y0,x0,y0] once and validate original bounds
crop.boundary_rule: Reject local fusion evidence within <=2 resized content pixels of any artificial crop edge; true original-image edges are exempt

matching.anchor_scope: All eligible global candidates whose expanded integer envelopes fit a selected ROI; not only ROI seeds
matching.local_union_nms_rule: Greedy same-class suppression at IoU>0.7, descending local confidence, then ROI ID and per-view row ID; preserve the winning source ROI
matching.pair_eligibility: Same class; local evidence passes the artificial-edge guard; global expanded envelope fits that local detection's source ROI
matching.assignment: Greedy sorted eligible pairs; each global and each retained local ID consumed once across both ROIs; match once using original global boxes/scores for both fusion variants

V2.geometry_order: Ascending global ID; compare proposed float32 box with the current output boxes
V2.collision_veto: For any other same-class current box: reject if IoU(proposed,other)>max(0.7,IoU(current_anchor,other))
V2.geometry_rejection_action: Retain original global coordinates and V1 score; do not rematch

fusion.protected: All global class IDs/counts; every noneligible global row's coordinates and score; eligible V1 coordinates; all original confidence>=0.25 rows
fusion.final_order: Stable descending updated confidence, original global ID ties; exact original rows/order when no field changes
fusion.max_det_action: Assert final count equals global count<=300; never truncate to make a violation pass
fusion.duplicate_claim: Prevent added rows and new/increased same-class overlap above 0.7; inherited baseline duplicates can remain

numerics.coordinates: Continuous xyxy image edges, no +1 pixel area convention
numerics.design_calculations: CPU float64 for scores, IoU, planning and matching; keep original float32 rows and IDs
numerics.v2_validation: Clip proposed coordinates, quantize to float32, then apply validity/collision checks to the committed values
numerics.thresholds: Inclusive >= except candidate confidence upper bound <0.25 and suppression/collision tests >
numerics.invalid_inputs: Stop and retain failure evidence; never silently discard malformed/non-finite global rows

phase_3c2_plan.technical_pilot: Same fixed 24-image Phase 3B pilot plus synthetic edge fixtures; no outcome-based image replacement

proposed_success.overall_map50_95: Positive point difference and paired 95 percent lower bound>0
proposed_success.fp_ratio_applies_to: All-class and fracture counts at confidence 0.25 / IoU 0.50; report uncertainty, not a clinical threshold
proposed_success.meaning: Engineering decision gates, not measured outcomes or statistically established noninferiority margins

phase_3c2_plan.stopping: Two initial variants only; stop after technical failure or one complete predefined comparison. No AP-driven parameter revision without a separately documented student-approved phase.
phase_3c2_plan.final_matrix: Select one common adaptive rule before class-aware inference/final test; V1/V2 are development alternatives, not extra main training conditions

parameter_basis.inherited: 768, EMA/precision, confidence 0.001, NMS 0.7, max_det 300, mapping, split, pinned evaluator
parameter_basis.evidence_motivated_not_optimized: Target classes and 64/32 size-priority references; Phase 3B proximity counts do not establish coverage for the narrower confidence interval
parameter_basis.requested_engineering_defaults: 0.05<=p<0.25, weights 0.6/0.4, max two ROIs, 0.75 crop fraction, V1 IoU 0.50/local 0.25/+0.10 cap
parameter_basis.new_engineering_hypotheses_requiring_app: Minimum short side 1, shared 2-pixel geometry/boundary margins, ROI overlap 0.7 plus containment, all covered eligible anchors, V2 IoU>=0.50 with 0.25 blend, local-only NMS, no final global NMS, decision gates
parameter_basis.mathematical_necessities: Finite positive geometry, outward integer bounds, deterministic tie rules, exact one-to-one assignment, one checkpoint per run, max 3 passes
parameter_basis.rejected_initial_alternative: Unconditional coordinate replacement at IoU 0.35-0.50; it weakens correspondence without evidence of better localization
